name: glm-sc410-tp2-vision-mtp
_comment: Portable configuration example: host, user and private workspace paths are placeholders, not original measured infrastructure. Historical context follows; this is not a new qualification claim. The turboderp GLM-5.3-Flash-exl3 sc_4.10bpw pack (exllamav3 1.6.2, 156.19 GiB: routed experts K4 with one layer at K5, attention and the shared experts K8, lm_head K6, an EXL3 K6 vision tower) as a two-rank tensor-parallel group on the GLM track's nodes: N3 = rank 0 (it holds the verified pack), N2 = rank 1 (a copy at the same path). Each rank maps the pack with its share of the routed experts (0..144 | 144..288) and reads and allocates only those; a rank that does not serve images claims and skips the vision tower (--no-vision; a follower always). The binary must be a build that maps this pack (branch glm/sc410-vision or later: older builds refuse its EXL3 tower even under --no-vision). NCCL as the other CRS812 kits (enP7s7, rocep1s0f0 and roceP2p1s0f0 and the env file are present on both gn100s, checked 2026-10-17). The launcher (rexl3-cluster) must have the gn100 deny list lifted (4ca3356b, on integ/main-families and nemotron/main; this file validates with that launcher, checked 2026-10-17): the GLM TP branches' launcher still refuses N2 and N3 by address. Not run yet: the figures are the rank planner's on the pack's header (crates/model/src/families/glm/tp_boot.rs the_sc410_ranks_plan_from_their_share, docs/GLM_TP.md section 12). Images WITH the pack's NextN layer drafting (--spec auto; the two-node tool's `mtp` variant swaps it for --spec mtp with REXL3_MTP_DEPTH=3): every rank also holds the NextN layer's trunk (replicated) and its share of the layer's experts (PASS_RULES_GLM_ADDENDUM_GEOMETRY D-G2). Rank 0 runs the EXL3 tower (0.416 GiB of weights, 0.72 GiB of scratch for 4,096-token images) and sends each chunk's rows; rank 1 claims and skips the tower. Rank 0 also holds the server's image-preparation credit (host memory for decoding and preparing images, HTTP side, rank 0 only): the group's leader_flags cap it at 1.125 GiB (--image-preparation-bytes 1207959552) instead of the 2 GiB default, to keep rank 0 within the box's 20 GiB MemAvailable rule (PASS_RULES_GLM_ADDENDUM_GEOMETRY D-G3; not plan-affecting: the follower serves no HTTP). 1.125 GiB, not D-G3's 1 GiB: the server charges one image's preparation as image_work_bytes(--max-image-tokens) = 4,096 x 32 KiB + 1 GiB (crates/server/src/preparation.rs) and refuses a request whose charge exceeds the cap, so a 1 GiB cap refused every image with 503 (lane G-2N 2026-10-17; proposed as D-G6). Images are prepared one at a time, as at the 2 GiB default (2 x 1.125 GiB > 2 GiB). nccl.lib names the CRS812 fabric's own NCCL build (2.30.7, the path the cluster.crs812-2node.json and cluster.smoke-2node.json kits use, byte-identical on N2 and N3): the gn100s have no system libnccl and the runtime guesses no directory (crates/cuda/src/nccl.rs), so without it the group cannot boot there (added by lane G-2N 2026-10-17, proposed to the main session as D-G5).
